stories_kpis.title: IVR Congress 2024: Strong Industry Convergence
stories_kpis.description: The annual IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17, 2024) attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries, featuring workshops on navigating inland waterway sustainability, safety culture, and regulatory frameworks. This marks consistent strong engagement with the organization's core mission of industry representation.

stories_kpis.title: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium Launch
stories_kpis.description: IVR successfully launched its first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024) with 80 participants, covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention. Eight presentations addressed critical topics including decarbonization impacts, motor valuation, classification societies, and clean shipping solutions.

company_description: Getlink SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, finance, construction, and operation of fixed link infrastructure and transport system in France and the United Kingdom. It operates through Eurotunnel, Europorte, and ElecLink segments. The Eurotunnel segment operates tunnels of a length of approximately 50 kilometres each under the English Channel, as well as terminals at Folkestone in the United Kingdom and the Coquelles in France. It also provides passenger shuttle services for the transport of trucks, cars, motor homes, caravans, coaches, motorcycles, trailers, commercial vans, and other vehicles. In addition, this segment manages passenger trains and rail freight, as well as fixed equipment and related installations. Its Europorte segment offers a range of integrated rail freight services, including national and international haulage, local services for secondary lines, individual junction management, infrastructure maintenance, and wagon loading and unloading services.
